thread.title: Apple's stock dives further in premarket, after Lumentum cuts outlook

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple's stock dives further in premarket, after Lumentum cuts outlook
text:
Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, -5.01% took a dive in premarket trade Monday, to be down 2.4%, after Lumentum Holdings Inc. LITE, -32.89% slashed its earnings and revenue outlook , saying it received a request from "one of its largest industrial and consumer customers for laser diodes for 3D sensing" to "materially reduce shipments" during the fiscal second quarter, which ends in December. Although Lumentum didn't name the customer, on its annual report for fiscal 2018 it listed Apple as its largest customer with 30% of revenue, followed by Huawei and Ciena Corp. CIEN, -3.02% both at 11%. Ciena's stock was still inactive. Apple's stock was down 0.9% just prior to Lumentum's announcement , then fell sharply after. Lumentum said it had no comment beyond what was in the press release, and Apple did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Lumentum's stock was halted for news until 8:30 a.m. Eastern. Lumentum's stock has rallied 14.4% year to date, while Apple shares have hiked up 20.8% and the S&P 500 SPX, -1.97% has gained 4.0%.
